reviewNotes:
Allô Père Noël lets a parent prepare a pretend phone call from Santa for their child. Everything is simulated inside the app: it never places or receives real calls, never uses CallKit, the microphone, the camera or the network (except the App Store purchase).

How to test: tap "Prepare a magic call", type a first name, pick up to two qualities, tap Continue, keep "The magic call" (free) and "Now", then tap "Start the call". An in-app incoming call screen rings; tap Answer. Santa (drawn and animated in SwiftUI) talks for about 90 seconds using the device's built-in speech synthesis, pauses so the child can answer (nothing is recorded), shows a star surprise and says goodbye. The end screen offers Replay, Create a keepsake (a card image shared with the iOS share sheet; photo access is only requested if the parent chooses Save Image) and Back to home.

One optional non-consumable purchase, "The full magic" (com.padelup.allonoel.magie): open it from a locked story or Settings > Unlock the full magic. A multiplication question for grown-ups is asked before buying. Restore is on the same screen and in Settings.

No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collection: the children's first names and details stay on the device and can be erased in Settings. The background melody is "Silent Night" (Franz Gruber, 1818, public domain), synthesized for the app. The font Fraunces is under the SIL Open Font License.
